_writeInNote: MaxFlares ran as a write-in for this race (source table literally tagged the column 'MaxFlares (write-in)'). Write-in support is well-documented in real-world polling to run hotter in a poll than at the ballot box -- respondents will happily tell a pollster they're writing someone in, then don't bother at the actual ballot. DDTSR's composite (activities.html) applies a discount to writeInIds before averaging; Spinner Insights' raw poll releases (polls.html) are left untouched since those are a historical record of what was actually reported.
